MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: P. Dias/S. Ravinantapricha, Reporter: Margaret Del Coto. Petitioner, Jonathan Alexander Condiri and Steve Kevin Conti were sworn and examined. The Court grants the decree changing names to Jonathan Alexander Conti and Steve Kevin Conti. Decrees signed in open court.
